beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The task makes a mundane possession carry questions about ownership and permission.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Elsewhere, apparently ownerless things reveal the power of a category.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel gives evidence texture through wear, damage, and remembered use.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its mystery depends on attending to those particulars rather than collecting slogans.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A catalogue can preserve a history or make a person disappear from it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The next rooms bring the inquiry closer to households and relationships.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Care and generosity can carry expectations that remain difficult to name.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book lets affected people complicate the roles assigned to them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their experiences resist being borrowed as convenient proof for someone else's position.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Mara's attention must become more careful than simple indignation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These encounters give the institutional story its emotional depth.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The question is not only what happened, but who may describe its meaning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The inquiry moves through work, convenience, and supposedly effortless public arrangements.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Time saved in one place may require effort somewhere less visible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel follows people whose contributions can vanish inside a successful explanation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also examines how accounts of invisible labor are themselves produced.
